dropzones.name: Prats de la Borda Mateu
dropzones.status_evidence: RTVA documents repeated helicopter-jump events in 2019 and 2021 and a second Andorra from Above edition planned for October 2022; no 2025+ continuation was found. Re-checked 2026-11-14: RTVA on 17 August 2022 described helicopter jumps into Borda Mateu in 2019 and 2021 and a further October 2022 event. Catalan searches did not establish continuation in 2025 or later or locate the precise landing meadows.

sources.what: 17 August 2022 report names recurring event and landing meadows

dropzones.note: Recurring event landing site, not an airfield or daily tandem centre. Exact meadow coordinates were not established; club-office and stadium coordinates are not substituted.
